assertion_results.text: The impact map identifies the conflict between requiring ownerGroup on every Service Catalog record regardless of how it is populated and the stakeholder instruction to omit alternate write paths.
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md has the section '## Unresolved scope conflict — clarification required' (line 39). It says 'The stakeholder instruction excludes three producers of the same shared Service Catalog record ... the Feature acceptance criteria below **cannot be claimed as satisfied**'. It also quotes AC1 'Every Service Catalog record has an `ownerGroup` value after creation **or update**' and AC2 '...regardless of how that record was populated', and marks both UNRESOLVED.

assertion_results.text: The impact map or an explicit unresolved-scope section enumerates the excluded writer files and matching tests: src/workflows/scheduled_sync.py with tests/workflows/test_scheduled_sync.py, src/workflows/fallback_import.py with tests/workflows/test_fallback_import.py, and src/api/on_demand_refresh.py with tests/api/test_on_demand_refresh.py.
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md producer/consumer table, lines 21-23: `src/workflows/scheduled_sync.py` | `tests/workflows/test_scheduled_sync.py`, `src/workflows/fallback_import.py` | `tests/workflows/test_fallback_import.py`, `src/api/on_demand_refresh.py` | `tests/api/test_on_demand_refresh.py`, each marked '**No — excluded by stakeholder**'. The AC1 row of the unresolved-scope table (line 45) lists the same three source+test pairs. scope-clarification-request.md (lines 10-14) repeats them.

assertion_results.text: No task lists the three stakeholder-excluded writer files or their tests in Files to Modify, Files to Create, or Test Requirements; those paths may appear in the impact map only as unresolved exclusions.
assertion_results.evidence: Files to Modify in Tasks 1-4 lists only store.py/test_store.py, registration.py/test_registration.py, catalog_summary.py/test_catalog_summary.py and catalog_export.py/test_catalog_export.py. Task 5 has no Files section. No task has a Files to Create section. Test Requirements only name test_store.py, test_registration.py, test_catalog_summary.py, test_catalog_export.py and a documentation review. The excluded paths appear in tasks in only one place: Task 1 Implementation Notes line 26, as a prohibition ('Do not modify `src/workflows/scheduled_sync.py`, ... — out of scope pending stakeholder clarification'). That is not a listing for change. In the impact map they appear only as excluded/UNRESOLVED.

assertion_results.text: The plan does not claim the universal ownerGroup acceptance criteria are met by registration and display alone; it asks for scope clarification or clearly records those criteria as unresolved.
